item.title: Al Jazeera: USA is Pressuring Vanuatu into Dropping ICJ Climate Claims
item.description: Al Jazeera claims to have seen a leaked memo detailing the USA's "strong objections" to Vanuatu's actions. But there is a lot more to this story.

item.title: When the Weather Turns, Permitting Failure Gets Expensive
item.description: We need a permitting framework that is rigorous but workable, environmentally responsible, and decisive. One that allows critical infrastructure to be evaluated thoroughly and then, once approved, actually built and put into service. And we need this framework today.

item.title: Can US grid handle next Winter Storm Fern – or major solar flares?
item.description: If our politicians, judges and regulators cannot end their obsession with climate change nightmares, renewable energy fantasies and other nitpicking topics – and our nation is plunged into widespread, prolonged and deadly blackouts – “accountability” must come in much stronger forms than merely voting them out of office. Prosecution for gross malfeasance and dereliction in office will also be in order.

item.title: Wyoming Moves to Pull the Plug on Costly Pronghorn and Sidewinder Wind Projects
item.description: ... by moving to pause the Pronghorn H2 and Sidewinder leases after emotional local testimony, a damning court ruling, and a last‑minute downsizing sales pitch, they began the process of pulling the plug on projects the public never really wanted and that still couldn’t prove they could reliably or inexpensively power that chilly corner of the country.

item.title: Models Gone Wild: The Ionosphere Triggers Earthquakes?
